subject.title: fix (Computer Use) Stabilize Codex Computer Use readiness

question: Should OpenClaw land this PR's opt-in Computer Use readiness, cache, health, repair, lease, and ChatGPT.app-first desktop behavior as the supported Codex Computer Use path?
rationale: Code and proof support the implementation, but the added config/env surface and macOS desktop precedence are compatibility and product-support choices that automation should not silently own.

options.title: Accept the expanded supported path
options.body: Land the PR with the current compatibility defaults and document the opt-in cache, health, strict-readiness, repair, and lease controls as supported Computer Use operations.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the author to defer health, repair, lease, or shared-cache controls and land only the readiness and ChatGPT.app path fix.

options.title: Pause for owner design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want Computer Use cache ownership or desktop bundle precedence decided in a separate design pass.

recommendation.title: Accept the expanded supported path
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the current compatibility defaults and document the opt-in cache, health, strict-readiness, repair, and lease controls as supported Computer Use operations.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Computer Use setup surface that this PR changes, so they are the best history-backed owner for the compatibility decision.
